# Beacon · Flare AI OS

> Conversation product for Flare rails: signal → quote → policy → pay → execute → receipt.

## Product
- Flow: chat agents for FTSO signals, SparkDEX (Flare Mainnet), LayerZero OFT bridge (Coston2 source), x402 pay, Bound Work
- Policy: server-enforced spend limits
- Networks: Coston2 (114) for FTSO / FAssets / OFT / x402; Flare Mainnet (14) for SparkDEX execute

## Links
- App: /flow
- Bound Work: /flow/desk
- Policy: /flow/security

## Honesty
- No simulated FCC attestation presented as verified
- Explorer links are network-correct (Coston2 vs flarescan.com)
- Model badges show exact Agent Router ids or "deterministic fallback"
